panels.title: Stage latency p50 / p99 (µs), every event

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, labels['stage'] AS stage, quantileExactWeighted(0.5)(le, c) / 1e3 AS p50, quantileExactWeighted(0.99)(le, c) / 1e3 AS p99 FROM market.metrics_histogram ARRAY JOIN buckets.le AS le, buckets.count AS c WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_ns' AND labels['trace'] = '${trace}' AND labels['stage'] != 'total' GROUP BY time, stage ORDER BY time

panels.description: From the always-on stage histograms: every event, sampled or not.

panels.title: Share of total time by stage

targets.rawSql: SELECT labels['stage'] AS stage, sum(sum) AS ns FROM market.metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND name = 'trace_ns' AND labels['trace'] = '${trace}' AND labels['stage'] != 'total' GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage

panels.title: Slowest traces (pick one in the trace_id menu)

targets.rawSql: SELECT Timestamp, TraceId, ServiceName, SpanName, Duration / 1e3 AS duration_us, SpanAttributes['why'] AS why FROM market.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' AND SpanName = '${trace}' ORDER BY Duration DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Why traces were kept

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS time, SpanAttributes['why'] AS why, count() AS traces FROM market.otel_traces WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND ParentSpanId = '' GROUP BY time, why ORDER BY time

panels.description: sampled: one in `sample`; slow: slower than `slower_than`; span: a `tracing` span.

targets.rawSql: SELECT TraceId AS traceID, SpanId AS spanID, ParentSpanId AS parentSpanID, ServiceName AS serviceName, SpanName AS operationName, toUnixTimestamp64Nano(Timestamp) / 1000000 AS startTime, Duration / 1000000 AS duration, arrayMap(key -> map('key', key, 'value', SpanAttributes[key]), mapKeys(SpanAttributes)) AS tags, arrayMap(key -> map('key', key, 'value', ResourceAttributes[key]), mapKeys(ResourceAttributes)) AS serviceTags FROM market.otel_traces WHERE TraceId = '${trace_id}' ORDER BY startTime
